answer: AI agents resist Sybil attacks using remote attestation rooted in trusted hardware enclaves. Whether trading sable pelts or onyx reserves, each agent must supply cryptographic quotes signed by tamper-resistant silicon. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of purchasing dedicated physical processors per identity, preventing an exponential spiral of forged peers. A primary limitation is that hardware side-channel exploits or compromised vendor keys can silently break identity integrity.
